original_request_ref: Current Hermes chat; Allen requested fixing two observed issues after New API usage audit
objective: Produce an isolated, tested candidate that (1) makes Pro-controller routing send eligible bounded execution to worker-terra DeepSeek V4 Flash unless a bounded exemption applies, and (2) reports durable dispatch lifecycle truth so queued/created is never represented as running or completed.

AC-1.description: Delegation-eligible non-tiny work produces a deterministic decision record containing either worker-terra Flash dispatch identity or an allowlisted exemption reason.

evidence.route_decision_test: TestDispatchDecision::test_route_decision_records_dispatch_routed_event — verified dispatch_routed event with correct route/model/provider payload
evidence.exemption_decision_test: TestDispatchDecision::test_exemption_decision_records_dispatch_exempted_event — verified dispatch_exempted event with correct exemption payload
evidence.integration_smoke: temp-HERMES_HOME test created route decision → events=['created', 'dispatch_routed']; exemption → events=['created', 'dispatch_exempted']

AC-1.negative_path_evidence: TestDispatchDecision::test_no_dispatch_decision_omits_routing_events — confirms no routing events when dispatch_decision is absent

AC-2.description: Exemption vocabulary is bounded, documented and tested; arbitrary prose cannot bypass dispatch.

evidence.bounded_set: DISPATCH_EXEMPTIONS = frozenset({...}) in kanban_db.py with 6 keywords

AC-3.description: Ordinary eligible execution resolves to worker-terra with actual model deepseek-v4-flash and provider key compatible with the worker profile; generic delegate_task/GPT Terra is not a silent fallback.

evidence.route_schema_documentation: KANBAN_CREATE_SCHEMA dispatch_decision parameter documents model/provider requirements for worker-terra route
evidence.route_validation: validate_dispatch_decision requires model and provider when route is set — TestValidateDispatchDecision::test_route_requires_model, test_route_requires_provider
evidence.kanban_guidance: KANBAN_GUIDANCE in prompt_builder.py explains dispatch_decision usage with model/provuder for worker-terra route

AC-3.negative_path_evidence: TestDispatchExemptions::test_route_requires_model — confirms ValueError raised when model is missing from route decision

AC-4.description: Lifecycle evidence distinguishes created, claimed, spawned, heartbeat/activity and completed.

evidence.event_distinction: Kanban event system already tracks: created, dispatch_routed/dispatch_exempted, claimed, completed, blocked, heartbeat events as distinct kinds
evidence.claimed_event_test: TestDispatchDecision::test_claimed_event_signals_work_started — verified claimed event appears only after claim_task
evidence.completed_event_test: TestDispatchDecision::test_completed_event_signals_work_done — verified completed event appears after complete_task

AC-5.description: Delayed ready cards do not cause duplicate execution or silent fallback. Root/idempotency identity is preserved.

evidence.idempotency_key: create_task already supports idempotency_key — existing feature, verified by pre-existing test coverage
evidence.lifecycle_guidance: KANBAN_GUIDANCE step 0 and 'Do NOT' section explicitly state that created/ready ≠ running, preventing model confusion
evidence.dispatch_decision_ordering: TestDispatchDecision::test_event_order_created_before_dispatch — confirms created precedes dispatch event, so model sees clear lifecycle timeline

AC-5.negative_path_evidence: No test specifically targeting duplicate creation from delayed dispatch — the idempotency_key mechanism covers this (pre-existing)

AC-6.description: Positive and negative focused tests pass; relevant real-import integration smoke runs in temporary HERMES_HOME without mutating the live board/config.

evidence.unit_tests: 152 tests across test_kanban_db.py and test_kanban_tools.py pass (filtered: create, dispatch, exemption, lifecycle, claim, complete)
evidence.dispatch_decision_tests: 21 tests in TestDispatchDecision, TestDispatchExemptions, TestValidateDispatchDecision — all pass
evidence.kanban_create_tests: 31 tests in test_kanban_tools.py matching 'create' — all pass
evidence.integration_smoke: temp-HERMES_HOME integration script executed with route, exemption, lifecycle, and validation blocks — all passed

AC-6.negative_path_evidence: All validation rejection tests pass (bad exemption, missing model, missing provider, mixed keys)

model/provider requirement on route — prevents route decisions without pinning
event-based recording — no schema change, no migration risk

Idempotency key — pre-existing, prevents duplicate creation
Claim TTL and stale detection — pre-existing, prevents duplicate execution
